description: Vietnam Wind Measurements Moit WB is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Wind", published or maintained by Clara Ivanescu (World Bank Group). Data repository for measurements from 2 lidar devices in the Maldives. Please refer to the country project page for additional outputs and reports, including installation reports: For access to maps and GIS layers, please visit the Global Wind Atlas: Please cite as: [Data/information/map obtained from the] “World Bank via ENERGYDATA.info, under a project funded by ... Coverage: Vietnam. It has 1 file in CSV. The portal files it under Wind. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
